attrs.name: recoverable succession / explicit terminalization
attrs.statement: For a Locus whose policy declares continued service, if the current holder becomes permanently unavailable and sufficient admissible loss evidence is eventually established, the system eventually (A) admits exactly one successor in a later generation, or (B) moves the Locus to an explicit terminal/quarantined state; it never remains silently ambiguous forever. L1 must not weaken S1/S2; a system may choose halt-on-loss and promise only (B).
attrs.status_text: candidate — NOT promoted (GPT v3 §11); L1-PRE + a temporal witness under declared fairness; TLC twin unexecuted
